{# nodrill override of Shibuya's layout.html. layout.html redeclares the `footer` block inside its own `document`, so emptying it in base.html alone leaves the footer on every page that inherits from here (404, simple, landing). Empty it a second time so the whole site ends on its own content. #} {%- extends "!layout.html" -%} {%- block footer -%}{%- endblock -%}
